text: Android: no session resume — every app start demands full re-login
relates: T-28 — T-28's login-then-redeem token stash should ride on this ticket's session-resume/startDestination rework rather than being bolted on before it.

Impl gotcha: the start-destination decision is genuinely async and can't be
computed synchronously in NavHost's startDestination. SessionStore.token is a
blocking Keystore/EncryptedSharedPreferences read and ServerConfig.serverUrl is
an async DataStore Flow. Either read the token synchronously in MainActivity
before setContent(), or add a short loading/splash destination while both
resolve. Also: LoginViewModel never prefills the server URL at init today —
onServerUrlChange() exists but nothing collects ServerConfig.serverUrl on
construction, so that prefill is net-new wiring, not just relocating a call.
